guard: operator manager-log guidance is derived from the same writer-owned path helper at all three shipped messages

mutations.name: the held-lease refusal goes back to the stale root-scoped manager log
mutations.find: console.error(c.red(`✗ a manager lease for "${space}" is still held by an unresponsive holder (pid ${launchHeld.pid}) after its TTL - stop it or check ${managerLogDisplayPath(space)}`));
mutations.replace: console.error(c.red(`✗ a manager lease for "${space}" is still held by an unresponsive holder (pid ${launchHeld.pid}) after its TTL - stop it or check .cotal/manager.log`));
mutations.expectRed: the held-lease refusal derives its logfile guidance
mutations.cell: the held-lease refusal derives its logfile guidance

mutations.name: the manager-readiness refusal goes back to the stale root-scoped manager log
mutations.find: console.error(c.red(`✗ manager did not become ready for control - see ${managerLogDisplayPath(space)}`));
mutations.replace: console.error(c.red(`✗ manager did not become ready for control - see .cotal/manager.log`));
mutations.expectRed: the manager-readiness refusal derives its logfile guidance
mutations.cell: the manager-readiness refusal derives its logfile guidance

mutations.name: the up success line goes back to the stale root-scoped manager log
mutations.expectRed: the up success line derives its logfile guidance
mutations.cell: the up success line derives its logfile guidance

mutations.name: the operator display helper stops resolving through the writer-owned path
mutations.expectRed: the operator path is the writer-owned manager logfile relative to the mesh root
mutations.cell: the operator path is the writer-owned manager logfile relative to the mesh root
